schemaStability: Stable field names and meanings. Described in 1.0.0: metadata.session, metadata.legisSessionId and metadata.generatedAt, plus a trailing `session` column on members.csv. metadata.session is present from the 2026-10 legis.ga.gov migration onward and ABSENT in snapshots taken before it, so it is documented but not `required` — every roster published since that migration carries it, and the publisher refuses to emit one that does not.
title: Georgia General Assembly — Members
description: Georgia state legislators, sourced from the General Assembly's own web service at legis.ga.gov. NOTE: also includes 4 statewide executives (chamber == 'executive'); filter to chamber in ['Senate', 'House of Representatives'] for legislators only. The target repo splits this file into house.json / senate.json.

metadata.description: Provenance for THIS file. This roster is the CURRENT biennium only and is overwritten in place when a new General Assembly is seated; prior bienniums are preserved under sessions/<slug>/ (see latest.json's rosterArchive).

session.description: The General Assembly session this roster describes, e.g. '2025_26'. Changes at a biennium rollover; the same value is in the `session` column of members.csv.

legisSessionId.description: legis.ga.gov's own numeric id for that session (Session/GetSessions), e.g. 1033.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 time this roster was last regenerated from legis.ga.gov. Freshness, not scope: it advances daily within one session.

id.description: An OPAQUE HANDLE: the stable string this member was first assigned, which never changes. It is the join key into votes.json's memberVotes and nothing else -- do not parse or interpret it. Some values happen to be Open States OCD person ids and others are 'legis-<legisGaGovId>'; neither shape is a promise, so read ocdPersonId for an OCD id. The PRIMARY, authoritative identity is legisGaGovId.

ocdPersonId.description: Open States OCD person id, or null. A cross-reference that can arrive after a member is seated; never the key. See idProvenance for why a value is null.

ballotpediaId.description: Ballotpedia page title, or null. Cross-reference.

idProvenance.description: Per-slot provenance: method, source, confidence. A null slot is distinguished as confidence 'no-match' (we looked, the source has no record), 'ambiguous' (more than one fit, none picked) or method 'unresolved' (no lookup has run yet).

name.description: The name as commonly used, which can differ from the formal name legis.ga.gov returns ('Tim Bearden' vs 'Timothy Bearden').

committees.description: Committee names exactly as legis.ga.gov publishes them.

legisGaGovId.description: The General Assembly's own member id, and the stable join key. Null only for the statewide executives, who are not members of the legislature.

leadershipRole.description: Chamber or committee leadership title, e.g. 'Speaker of the House', 'Chairman, House Committee on Appropriations'. Null for a rank-and-file member.

residence.description: The city the member gives as home — not an address.
